prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a hit while turning left. The patient had 3 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1040; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient presented after a collision in which another vehicle struck the patient's car while the patient was turning left. The patient reported neck pain and stiffness beginning shortly after the impact, consistent with a whiplash-type mechanism for a crash of this kind. Over three visits, the patient was managed with a standard course of conservative care, including range-of-motion exercises, the use of a cervical collar for a short period, and as-needed anti-inflammatory medication. Examination findings included reduced cervical range of motion and tenderness over the paraspinal muscles, which support the reported injury. Neurological screening and imaging-related assessments were within normal limits. The patient reported no prior injury to the neck or upper back. Symptoms improved steadily, and care was tapered and then discontinued as the patient's function returned toward baseline. Two charges with similar service descriptions submitted on the same day are currently under review by the billing office.
